summary: Repaired STU-014 by route (a). Hilary on Mt 9:8 stays in the third reading, rendered as a power and a way given now through Christ's word, whose end is the resurrection and the return to heaven. The comparison's shared ground now says truly that none of the readings takes a sense of the ministry from a Father's reading of the crowd's praise. It names all four places the second reading takes that sense (Ambrose, Exp. in Lc. V.13; Aquinas at v. 6; Schuster's third sense of v. 8; the continuation on the keys and Penance) and says how each reading hears the Postcommunion's perficias. The first reading's prayers subsection now makes that true of the first reading. A new paragraph sets out the Chrysostom/Ambrose-versus-Hilary disagreement over v. 8: which reading uses which side, and what that changes. The false 'No witness sets one reading's use of a text against another's' is removed. Advisories STU-010, STU-011 and STU-015 to STU-019 were cleared while in those files. research/interpretations.md section 4.3 still says that no reading turns on v. 8. This stage does not edit research, so that drift is reported for the reviewer to route.
